leases.focus: Reconcile only facts proven by repository evidence after W10 QC: (1) register the repaired F1/F2 control-plane defects and their repair commits; (2) add W10 evidence and its independent QC rejection to evidence memory without claiming acceptance; (3) reconcile stale WAVE-0011 / mission-state / unpromoted-attempt counts to current known facts, preserving prior values as historical; (4) re-scope BLOCKER-0005 using currently verifiable worker refs and do not close it; (5) preserve BLOCKER-0004 lineage divergence as OPEN/UNDECIDED; (6) explicitly supersede the false Wave 10 claims in WORK-0006 PRE-GATE-BASELINE.md with a correction section while preserving the original text; (7) do not promote any product or worker code; (8) do not modify .github/**, Architecture Freeze V4/V4.1, product code, tests, or accepted F1-F6/CCC/UX work. The result must make the next acceptance wave capable of judging the team without historical contradictions masquerading as current truth.
